mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environment_monthly_data ( company_id, facility_id, base_period, electricity_usage_kwh, production_ton, intensity_kwh_per_ton, emission_factor, scope2_tco2eq, validation_status, collection_status, reflection_status, approval_status, collected_at, updated_at ) SELECT f.company_id, f.id, #{basePeriod}, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 56000 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 428500 WHEN '울산공장' THEN 395200 ELSE 180000 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 640 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 5480 WHEN '울산공장' THEN 4570 ELSE 2400 END, ROUND((CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 56000 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 428500 WHEN '울산공장' THEN 395200 ELSE 180000 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 640 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 5480 WHEN '울산공장' THEN 4570 ELSE 2400 END, 0), 4), 0.0004594, ROUND((CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 56000 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 428500 WHEN '울산공장' THEN 395200 ELSE 180000 END) * 0.0004594, 4), 'NORMAL', 'COLLECTED', 'NOT_REFLECTED', 'DRAFT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM company_facilities f WHERE f.company_id = #{companyId} ON CONFLICT (facility_id, base_period) DO UPDATE SET electricity_usage_kwh = EXCLUDED.electricity_usage_kwh, production_ton = EXCLUDED.production_ton, intensity_kwh_per_ton = EXCLUDED.intensity_kwh_per_ton, emission_factor = EXCLUDED.emission_factor, scope2_tco2eq = EXCLUDED.scope2_tco2eq, validation_status = EXCLUDED.validation_status, collection_status = 'COLLECTED', collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

hazard_total_count, hazard_completed_count, injury_rate, training_completion_rate, hazard_action_rate, turnover_rate, validation_status, collection_status, reflection_status, approval_status, THEN 8 ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN f.facility_name = '부산공장' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 37200 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 64100 ELSE 51500 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 238 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 412 ELSE 328 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 234 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 396 ELSE 319 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 11 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 16 ELSE 14 END, CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 10 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 14 ELSE 13 END, ROUND((CASE WHEN f.facility_name = '부산공장' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 238 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 412 ELSE 328 END, 0), 4), ROUND((CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 234 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 396 ELSE 319 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 238 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 412 ELSE 328 END, 0), 4), ROUND((CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 10 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 14 ELSE 13 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 11 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 16 ELSE 14 END, 0), 4), ROUND((CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 3 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 8 ELSE 6 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(CASE f.facility_name WHEN '서울 본사' THEN 238 WHEN '부산공장' THEN 412 ELSE 328 END, 0), 4), 'NORMAL', 'COLLECTED', 'NOT_REFLECTED', 'DRAFT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM company_facilities f WHERE f.company_id = #{companyId} ON CONFLICT (facility_id, base_period) DO UPDATE SET average_employees = EXCLUDED.average_employees, exit_count = EXCLUDED.exit_count, injured_employee_count = EXCLUDED.injured_employee_count, total_work_hours = EXCLUDED.total_work_hours, training_target_count = EXCLUDED.training_target_count, training_completed_count = EXCLUDED.training_completed_count, hazard_total_count = EXCLUDED.hazard_total_count, hazard_completed_count = EXCLUDED.hazard_completed_count, injury_rate = EXCLUDED.injury_rate, training_completion_rate = EXCLUDED.training_completion_rate, hazard_action_rate = EXCLUDED.hazard_action_rate, turnover_rate = EXCLUDED.turnover_rate, validation_status = EXCLUDED.validation_status, collection_status = 'COLLECTED', collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO governance_monthly_data ( company_id, headquarters_facility_id, base_period, board_meeting_status, board_meeting_count, total_director_seats, attended_director_seats, total_directors, outside_directors, ethics_target_count, ethics_completed_count, board_attendance_rate, outside_director_rate, ethics_completion_rate, validation_status, collection_status, reflection_status, approval_status, collected_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{companyId}, (SELECT id FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND facility_type = 'HQ' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), #{basePeriod}, 'HELD', 1, 8, 7, 8, 3, 1250, 1230, 87.5000, 37.5000, 98.4000, 'NORMAL', 'COLLECTED', 'NOT_REFLECTED', 'DRAFT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON CONFLICT (company_id, base_period) DO UPDATE SET headquarters_facility_id = EXCLUDED.headquarters_facility_id, board_meeting_status = EXCLUDED.board_meeting_status, board_meeting_count = EXCLUDED.board_meeting_count, total_director_seats = EXCLUDED.total_director_seats, attended_director_seats = EXCLUDED.attended_director_seats, total_directors = EXCLUDED.total_directors, outside_directors = EXCLUDED.outside_directors, ethics_target_count = EXCLUDED.ethics_target_count, ethics_completed_count = EXCLUDED.ethics_completed_count, board_attendance_rate = EXCLUDED.board_attendance_rate, outside_director_rate = EXCLUDED.outside_director_rate, ethics_completion_rate = EXCLUDED.ethics_completion_rate, collection_status = 'COLLECTED', collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO integration_raw_data ( run_id, company_id, facility_id, domain, source_system, source_record_id, base_period, payload, validation_status, collected_at ) SELECT #{runId}, e.company_id, e.facility_id, 'ENVIRONMENT', 'EMS', 'EMS-' || e.facility_id || '-' || REPLACE(#{basePeriod}, '-', ''), #{basePeriod}, jsonb_build_object('electricityUsageKwh', e.electricity_usage_kwh, 'productionTon', e.production_ton, 'unit', 'kWh'), e.validation_status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM environment_monthly_data e WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.base_period = #{basePeriod} ON CONFLICT (company_id, source_system, source_record_id) DO UPDATE SET run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, payload = EXCLUDED.payload, validation_status = EXCLUDED.validation_status, error_message = NULL, collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_metric_data ( company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, activity_value, numerical_value, emission_factor_id, evidence_file_url, status, data_source_type, input_user_id, additional_info, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT e.company_id, e.facility_id, i.id, SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT, 'MONTHLY', SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 6, 2)::INT, e.electricity_usage_kwh, CASE i.indicator_code WHEN 'IND_E_ELEC' THEN e.electricity_usage_kwh ELSE e.scope2_tco2eq END, CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' THEN ef.factor_id END, '/demo/evidence/' || REPLACE(e.base_period, '-', '') || '_' || LOWER(i.indicator_code) || '.pdf', 'DRAFT', CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' THEN 'CALCULATION' ELSE 'API' END, #{userId}, jsonb_build_object('basePeriod', e.base_period, 'sourceSystem', 'EMS', 'productionTon', e.production_ton, 'intensityKwhPerTon', e.intensity_kwh_per_ton, 'emissionFactor', e.emission_factor, 'reflectionStatus', 'REFLECTED', 'evaluationType', 'KCGS_ALIGNED_INTERNAL'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM environment_monthly_data e CROSS JOIN esg_indicators i LEFT JOIN emission_factors ef ON ef.energy_type = 'ELECTRICITY_KR' AND ef.reference_year = SUBSTRING(e.base_period, 1, 4)::INT WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.base_period = #{basePeriod} AND e.collection_status = 'COLLECTED' AND e.reflection_status = 'NOT_REFLECTED' AND e.approval_status != 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code IN ('IND_E_ELEC', 'IND_E_SCOPE2') AND e.facility_id = #{facilityId} ON CONFLICT (company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value) DO UPDATE SET activity_value = EXCLUDED.activity_value, numerical_value = EXCLUDED.numerical_value, emission_factor_id = EXCLUDED.emission_factor_id, evidence_file_url = EXCLUDED.evidence_file_url, status = CASE WHEN esg_metric_data.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED'::data_status_enum ELSE 'DRAFT'::data_status_enum END, data_source_type = EXCLUDED.data_source_type, input_user_id = EXCLUDED.input_user_id, reject_reason = NULL, additional_info = EXCLUDED.additional_info, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO esg_metric_data ( company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, activity_value, numerical_value, evidence_file_url, status, data_source_type, input_user_id, additional_info, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT s.company_id, s.facility_id, i.id, SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 1, 4)::INT, 'MONTHLY', SUBSTRING(s.base_period, 6, 2)::INT, CASE i.indicator_code WHEN 'IND_S_INJURY_RATE' THEN s.injured_employee_count WHEN 'IND_S_SAFETY_EDU' THEN s.training_completed_count WHEN 'IND_S_RISK_ACTION' THEN s.hazard_completed_count ELSE s.exit_count END, CASE i.indicator_code WHEN 'IND_S_INJURY_RATE' THEN s.injury_rate WHEN 'IND_S_SAFETY_EDU' THEN s.training_completion_rate WHEN 'IND_S_RISK_ACTION' THEN s.hazard_action_rate ELSE s.turnover_rate END, '/demo/evidence/' || REPLACE(s.base_period, '-', '') || '_social.xlsx', 'DRAFT', 'CALCULATION', #{userId}, jsonb_build_object('basePeriod', s.base_period, 'sourceSystem', 'HR_SAFETY', 'averageEmployees', s.average_employees, 'trainingTargetCount', s.training_target_count, 'hazardTotalCount', s.hazard_total_count, 'reflectionStatus', 'REFLECTED', 'evaluationType', 'KCGS_ALIGNED_INTERNAL'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM social_monthly_data s CROSS JOIN esg_indicators i WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.base_period = #{basePeriod} AND s.collection_status = 'COLLECTED' AND s.reflection_status = 'NOT_REFLECTED' AND s.approval_status != 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code IN ('IND_S_INJURY_RATE', 'IND_S_SAFETY_EDU', 'IND_S_RISK_ACTION', 'IND_S_TURNOVER') AND s.facility_id = #{facilityId} ON CONFLICT (company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value) DO UPDATE SET activity_value = EXCLUDED.activity_value, numerical_value = EXCLUDED.numerical_value, evidence_file_url = EXCLUDED.evidence_file_url, status = CASE WHEN esg_metric_data.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED'::data_status_enum ELSE 'DRAFT'::data_status_enum END, data_source_type = EXCLUDED.data_source_type, input_user_id = EXCLUDED.input_user_id, reject_reason = NULL, additional_info = EXCLUDED.additional_info, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO esg_metric_data ( company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, activity_value, numerical_value, text_value, evidence_file_url, status, data_source_type, input_user_id, additional_info, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT g.company_id, g.headquarters_facility_id, i.id, SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 1, 4)::INT, 'MONTHLY', SUBSTRING(g.base_period, 6, 2)::INT, CASE i.indicator_code WHEN 'IND_G_ATTENDANCE' THEN g.attended_director_seats WHEN 'IND_G_OUTSIDE' THEN g.outside_directors ELSE g.ethics_completed_count END, CASE i.indicator_code WHEN 'IND_G_ATTENDANCE' THEN g.board_attendance_rate WHEN 'IND_G_OUTSIDE' THEN g.outside_director_rate ELSE g.ethics_completion_rate END, CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_G_ATTENDANCE' AND g.board_meeting_status = 'NOT_HELD' THEN '이사회 미개최' END, '/demo/evidence/' || REPLACE(g.base_period, '-', '') || '_governance.pdf', 'DRAFT', CASE WHEN i.indicator_code = 'IND_G_ATTENDANCE' THEN 'DOCUMENT_AI' ELSE 'API' END, #{userId}, jsonb_build_object('basePeriod', g.base_period, 'sourceSystem', 'GROUPWARE', 'boardMeetingStatus', g.board_meeting_status, 'reflectionStatus', 'REFLECTED', 'evaluationType', 'KCGS_ALIGNED_INTERNAL'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM governance_monthly_data g CROSS JOIN esg_indicators i WHERE g.company_id = #{companyId} AND g.base_period = #{basePeriod} AND g.collection_status = 'COLLECTED' AND g.reflection_status = 'NOT_REFLECTED' AND g.approval_status != 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code IN ('IND_G_ATTENDANCE', 'IND_G_OUTSIDE', 'IND_G_ETHICS_EDU') ON CONFLICT (company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value) DO UPDATE SET activity_value = EXCLUDED.activity_value, numerical_value = EXCLUDED.numerical_value, text_value = EXCLUDED.text_value, evidence_file_url = EXCLUDED.evidence_file_url, status = CASE WHEN esg_metric_data.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'APPROVED'::data_status_enum ELSE 'DRAFT'::data_status_enum END, data_source_type = EXCLUDED.data_source_type, input_user_id = EXCLUDED.input_user_id, reject_reason = NULL, additional_info = EXCLUDED.additional_info, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO esg_approval_history ( metric_data_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, comment, actor_user_id, acted_at ) SELECT m.id, 'REFLECT', NULL::data_status_enum, 'DRAFT'::data_status_enum, '월간 원천 데이터를 ESG 지표로 반영했습니다.', #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{basePeriod}, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(#{basePeriod}, 6, 2)::INT AND i.category::text = #{domain} AND m.status = 'DRAFT' AND m.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM esg_approval_history h WHERE h.metric_data_id = m.id AND h.action_type = 'REFLECT' )
mapper.update: UPDATE governance_monthly_data SET reflection_status = 'REFLECTED', approval_status = 'DRAFT', reflected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, approved_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND base_period = #{basePeriod} AND reflection_status = 'NOT_REFLECTED' AND approval_status != 'APPROVED'
